# Quiet Horizons

An original 80-second stereo ambient loop composed and synthesized for Parallax. No borrowed recordings or samples. Warm pads and a sparse glass motif follow Dmaj(add9), Bm9, Gmaj9, and Asus(add9).

The MP3 is 160 kbps stereo, 80.000 seconds, peak -5.45 dBFS and RMS -18.34 dBFS. Circular note and reverb rendering provides continuous loop boundaries. The game adds a 1.5-second entrance fade and changes the mix with perspective.
